answer: Raise the price of a fresh identity by escrowing its bond against work it cannot pre-compute. Each new agent must attest a randomly drawn peer transaction chosen after it joins, so a garden of freshly minted keys cannot be seeded in advance. A hollow farm of a thousand clones then owes a thousand separate escrows plus a thousand unpredictable reads, paid in compute and capital per head rather than one config line. Bonds only vest after sustained correct attestations, and a cedar-style ring of shared standing is useless because kin attestations score zero, so cloning loses money on every key.
